metadata.title: Container Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for safely executing multiple containerized workloads on shared compute platforms while preserving isolation and platform trust.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Container platforms, shared-kernel execution environments, and container orchestration systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing baseline trust boundaries and isolation assumptions in containerized execution environments.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Container platforms assume a trusted virtualized or equivalent execution substrate.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Privilege escalation risks due to shared-kernel execution and elevated container capabilities.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Lateral movement between co-resident containers on a shared host or node.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Defense evasion via container boundary bypass or namespace abuse.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Escape to host from container due to kernel or runtime exploitation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Process injection techniques applicable within shared-kernel environments.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Execution isolation enforced between container workloads.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Kernel attack surface minimization relevant to container hosts.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Reduction of privileged interfaces exposed to containerized workloads.

metadata.remarks: Container Core defines the foundational trust properties required to operate containerized workloads on shared infrastructure. This pattern makes shared-kernel risks, isolation boundaries, and container-layer threat relevance explicit and assertable, without prescribing orchestration, runtime, or supply-chain controls.

components.title: Container Workload Isolation
components.description: Prevents unintended interaction or interference between containerized workloads.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Container workloads are isolated such that compromise of one does not permit access to others.

components.title: Container–Host Trust Boundary
components.description: Maintains separation between container workloads and the underlying host operating system.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Container workloads cannot influence or escape into the host execution context.

components.title: Container Lateral Movement Containment
components.description: Limits the ability of a compromised container to move laterally across shared container infrastructure.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Platform controls reduce lateral attack paths between containerized workloads.
